atmospheric_provenance.airmass: Kasten-Young 1989 relative air mass; absolute mass corrected by pressure_pa
atmospheric_provenance.dni: pvlib Ineichen modeled clear-sky direct normal irradiance; not measured
atmospheric_provenance.dni_extra: fixed nominal 1361 W/m2; not day-of-year dependent
atmospheric_provenance.linke_turbidity: fixed reference constant 3; not an observed or climatological lookup

clear_sky.reference_provenance: fixed idealized reference: nominal solar irradiance I0=1361 W/m2; Linke turbidity=3; pvlib Ineichen; Kasten-Young 1989 air mass; no date, seasonal correction, or Linke climatology lookup

limitations: Modeled direct incident irradiance, not measured; no terrain shadows, diffuse radiation or material absorption; HGT tile IDs do not certify source hashes

position.altitude_interpretation: NASADEM HGT orthometric elevation in meters; no ellipsoidal conversion applied
position.geometry_model: user-configured idealized solar geometry; no date or time
position.point_method: nearest valid prepared pixel center to projected shapely representative_point; row/col tie-break
position.pressure_provenance: dry standard atmosphere: p=1013.25*(max(1-2.25577e-5*h,1e-6)^5.25588) hPa; h is NASADEM EGM96 orthometric elevation in meters

palette_source.license: Matplotlib License (BSD-compatible); bundled standard Inferno LUT

preview.quantization: normalize [0,DNI_adjusted] to [0,1] (zero range -> 0); matplotlib 256-entry Inferno LUT; round RGBA*255 to uint8; invalid alpha=0; nearest-neighbor geographic reprojection

request.pressure_provenance: dry standard atmosphere: p=1013.25*(max(1-2.25577e-5*h,1e-6)^5.25588) hPa; h is NASADEM EGM96 orthometric elevation in meters
request.reference_provenance: fixed idealized reference: nominal solar irradiance I0=1361 W/m2; Linke turbidity=3; pvlib Ineichen; Kasten-Young 1989 air mass; no date, seasonal correction, or Linke climatology lookup
